method: For each outer fold,3 inner splits of6k train base18/global, spectral29/global, local18/V178 heads on4k and predict held2k. Fit w_s,w_l in[0,1.5] by BCE(z_base+w_s*(z_s-z_base)+w_l*(z_l-z_base))+.02/2*((w_s-1)^2+(w_l-1)^2). Apply weights to full6k corrected-Kumo heads; final=.75*sigmoid(eta)+.25*original_spline77; mean5fold test probabilities

spec.rationale: V185 fixed logit fusion increases pooledKS but only3/5folds and mixed public outcome. Learn complementarity using strictly inner-OOF predictions, never using in-sample original spline or outer labels for mixing weights. Difference from V185 includes fusion before original spline and training-only weight fit.
